remarks: Well maintained unit in the park-like complex near Westport. Large, bright living Rm/dining Area Combination with sliders to large balcony. Bedroom with walk-in closet. Plenty additional closet space. New hardwood floors. Rent includes heat & hot water. Unit is ranch style but located on the second floor. Condo complex offers in-ground pool, playground and beautifully maintained grounds with common courtyard. Assigned parking for one vehicle (additional space $15/mo). Basement storage unit. Laundry in adjacent building. Great location near Norwalk High School, walk to tennis courts & athletic fields in public school. Easy access to I-95 highway and Metro North Trains (Westport or Easy Norwalk Stations). Great Value!
